title: Thacker Pass Mining Permit Fact Sheet
summary: NDEP's fact sheet explains the geology, hydrology, mine components, monitoring approach, and permit-condition changes behind the Thacker Pass mining decisions.
key_findings: The fact sheet consolidates the state technical basis for the water and reclamation permits.
It describes how the project will be monitored and how permit conditions were revised.
The technical basis is not a later inspection, monitoring dataset, or compliance result.
why_it_matters: It makes the assumptions and monitoring design behind the permits easier to audit.
ftfn_relevance: Adds technical context to the formal permit records.
Identifies monitoring and hydrology questions for later follow-up.
Prevents permit summaries from substituting for measured performance.
evidence_limits: The fact sheet predates later construction and operating evidence.
It does not provide current monitoring, compliance, water, or production outcomes.
